title: Court Records Scraper: Case Law & Dockets

queries.title: Search queries
queries.description: What to search for, one per line. Keywords ("fair use copyright"), a party or company name ("Google"), or a case name. Each runs its own search.

recordType.title: Record type
recordType.description: Case law = published court opinions and decisions. Dockets = court case filings (parties, judge, docket number, dates).

courts.title: Courts
courts.description: Limit to specific courts by CourtListener court ID, one per line ("scotus" = Supreme Court, "cafc" = Federal Circuit, "ca9" = 9th Circuit, "dcd" = DC District). Leave empty for all courts.

filedAfter.title: Filed after
filedAfter.description: Only records filed on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Leave empty for no lower bound.

filedBefore.title: Filed before
filedBefore.description: Only records filed on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Leave empty for no upper bound.

sortBy.title: Sort by
sortBy.description: Order of results. Most cited applies to case law only.

maxPerQuery.title: Results per query
maxPerQuery.description: How many records to return per search.

maxRows.title: Max rows
maxRows.description: Stop after this many rows in total.
